title: King of the Last Call
paragraphs: The crew stands together while the city below turns gold. Influence held, Heat stayed below the line, and loyalty kept every chair filled.
Vincent is slightly forward, but the group is equal. The night ends with the table intact and the doors still open.

title: The Family Holds
paragraphs: The numbers are not a coronation. What holds is the crew, gathered after closing with the books shut and the lamps low.
Power can wait. The people at the table do not. Loyalty is the thing the night kept.

title: City Without a Boss
paragraphs: Heat, lost loyalty, or a city that would not be led leaves the office empty at dawn. Six chairs remain around the table.
No one name stays over the door. The night is over, and the city keeps moving without a boss.
